From the owner
Small repairs. Big projects. One local team. 29 Palms Handyman & Construction brings over 10 years of hands-on experience to residential, commercial, and military/government work. From ceiling fans, fixture repairs, and drywall patches to flooring, tile, kitchen and bathroom improvements, welding, fences, pool care, and recurring property maintenance, tell us what needs doing. Small jobs are welcome, and larger projects are reviewed by scope. We serve Twentynine Palms, Joshua Tree, Yucca Valley, Hemet, Banning, Desert Hot Springs, Palm Springs, Big Bear, and nearby communities. We come to your property. Send your task list, photos, job city, and ZIP code to discuss an estimate, availability, and scheduling.

From the owner
We've been showing off some of the deck projects we're working on right now, so we figured it was time to share one we wrapped up a little while back! This deck was ready for a refresh. Years of weather had taken their toll on the wood, leaving the surface faded and worn. Our team gave the entire deck the attention it needed, from prep work to the final finish, bringing it back to life with a clean, modern look that completely transformed the outdoor space. Now this deck is ready for backyard BBQs, family gatherings, and plenty more seasons to come. Whether you need a new deck, structural repairs, restoration, or professional staining, 4 Seasons Painting & Construction is here to help get the job done right. Serving Walla Walla and surrounding areas!
